  𝓥 ∈ σ.(mem) →
  (∀ `{noprolG Σ} tid, ⊢ WP e @ tid; ⊤ {{ v, ⌜φ v⌝ }}) →
  adequate NotStuck (e at 𝓥) σ (λ v _, φ v).
Proof.
